verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an extensive, first-party documented public JS/TS API (Scenes, GameObjects, Loader, Animations, Physics, Input, etc.) that any developer—including an AI agent generating code—can drive programmatically, and Phaser Studio additionally offers a dedicated Game Agent MCP server with 40+ tools letting AI coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Copilot) build games via natural language, confirmed live in the runtime probe. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable spec (OpenAPI 404, llms.txt initially 404 though later shown live as an examples index) and independent hands-on evidence of an AI agent successfully using the API/MCP server end-to-end.
